statement: Provide a cloud common data environment where a hub holds projects whose files live in a folder structure that can be seeded from project templates.

acceptance.corpus: create/move/delete operations on folder tree; model-based state check

notes: VERIFIED: Files tool, folders and project templates confirmed on the Files and Project Templates help pages. key=fdm_hub

statement: Upload supported files or whole folders and view 2D and 3D content in the browser.

acceptance.corpus: corpus: IFC4 samples, DWG/DXF samples (ODA public samples), glTF, OBJ, PDF; viewer opens and bounding box matches

notes: VERIFIED: Supported formats are listed on the Supported Files on Web page and include IFC, OBJ, SKP, 3DM, DWG and RVT. key=fdm_upload_view

statement: Create a new file version automatically on upload of the same name, show version history, promote an earlier version to current, and compare versions visually.

acceptance.corpus: restore returns byte-identical content (hash)

notes: VERIFIED: Version promotion and comparison are described on their own help pages. key=fdm_versions

statement: Control access per folder with permission levels assigned to members, roles and companies, with subfolder inheritance and file activity logs.

acceptance.corpus: role x action matrix; every cell tested (allow/deny)

notes: VERIFIED: Permission reports and activity logs are separate help pages. key=fdm_permissions

statement: Offer a lighter data management tier with a subset of tools alongside the full tier, sharing the same storage model.

source.ref: Data Management vs Data Management Essentials Comparison

acceptance.corpus: feature flags by tier honoured (config test)

notes: VERIFIED: Commercial packaging only; the Dino row is a feature flag model. key=fdm_essentials

statement: Connect desktop design applications to project files in the hub so models can be opened, saved and linked from the cloud.

source.ref: General capabilities: Desktop Connector and Design Apps

acceptance.corpus: open, edit, save via connector API; content hash and version number correct

notes: VERIFIED: Revit, AutoCAD and Civil 3D standalone subscriptions are named as including the lighter tier. key=fdm_desktop_links

statement: Search files by name, description, review status and custom attributes, filter by type, version and date, and keep saved searches.

acceptance.corpus: synthetic 10k-file corpus; recall and precision 1.0 on exact queries

notes: VERIFIED: Free-form tags are not described; custom attributes fill that role. key=fdm_search_meta

statement: Share files and folders with anyone through public links that expire after an administrator-chosen period, once public sharing is switched on.

source.ref: Share Files and Folders with Anyone with the Link

acceptance.corpus: link expires at set time (clock-injected test)

notes: VERIFIED: Guest accounts are not described on this page; link sharing to non-members is. key=fdm_sharing_external

statement: Let administrators choose the region for primary storage of project content, from eight regions for Data Management and fewer for Site Design.

acceptance.corpus: storage adapter refuses cross-region writes (negative test)

notes: VERIFIED: Data Management is offered in eight regions; Site Design in the US, EU and Australia. key=fdm_regions

statement: Let people download project files to the mobile app, work with them offline or with poor connectivity, and sync later.

acceptance.corpus: edit offline on two devices; merge preserves all non-conflicting edits (property test)

notes: VERIFIED: Offline work is described for the mobile apps; a desktop offline mode is not described. key=fdm_offline

statement: Export a folder permissions report that lists member, role and company permission levels for a folder and its subfolders or for all folders.

acceptance.corpus: report rows equal the permission table of a fixture project

notes: VERIFIED against the cited page.  key=new_data_permission_report

statement: Apply a file naming standard built from ordered attributes, based on the ISO 19650 series, to selected folders.

acceptance.corpus: upload a non-conforming name to an enforced folder; it is held or rejected, a conforming name is accepted

notes: VERIFIED against the cited page.  key=new_data_naming_standard

source.ref: Create, Edit and Delete Custom Attributes

acceptance.corpus: create three attribute types, mark one required, verify upload validation

notes: VERIFIED against the cited page.  key=new_data_custom_attributes

acceptance.corpus: upload a version that meets the condition; it becomes visible to the target group and the earlier version stays hidden

notes: VERIFIED against the cited page.  key=new_data_smart_controls

acceptance.corpus: upload a folder with an external reference; the reference resolves after upload

notes: VERIFIED against the cited page.  key=new_data_bulk_upload

statement: Create transmittals of selected files to project members, and to non-members when an administrator allows it.

acceptance.corpus: send a transmittal to a member and, with the setting on, to an external address

notes: VERIFIED against the cited page.  key=new_data_transmittal

acceptance.corpus: share a folder to a second project; copy appears and updates on source change

notes: VERIFIED against the cited page.  key=new_data_bridge

statement: Compare two versions of a file, or two views or pages, as an overlay or side by side in the viewer.

acceptance.corpus: compare two versions of a fixture drawing; the diff overlay marks the changed region

notes: VERIFIED against the cited page.  key=new_data_compare_versions
